page.title: SSH keys
page.subtitle: Generate or import private keys, then deploy their public key to a host. Private keys never leave this machine.
page.loadError: SSH keys could not be loaded

empty.title: No SSH keys yet
empty.text: Generate a new Ed25519 key, or import a private key you already have.

actions.forgottenText: The passphrase of {name} is no longer saved.
actions.deleteConflict: The file at this path no longer holds this key. Nothing was deleted.
actions.restrictedText: Key present with restrictions (options) on {host}; not changed. Edit authorized_keys by hand to allow normal logins.

fields.name: Name
fields.rememberPassphrase: Remember passphrase in the system keychain

delete.text: The key is removed from the list and any saved passphrase is forgotten.
delete.managedNote: Servers that trust this key can no longer be reached with it.
delete.sharedNote: Other tools may use this key.
delete.importedNote: The file stays where it is: it was imported, not generated here.

deploy.intro: Appends the public key of {name} to {file} on the host. You connect first, as usual.
deploy.useKey: Use this key for the host
deploy.useKeyNote: Sets the host's authentication to this key ({path}).

keygen.typeNote: Ed25519 is recommended. RSA 4096 is slower, for servers without Ed25519.
keygen.fileNameHint: Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'. The public key gets a .pub suffix.
keygen.savedAs: Saved as {file} and {pub} in this folder.
keygen.folderWarning: Other users can open this folder. The private key file stays readable only by you, but they may be able to replace or delete it.
keygen.rsaSlow: Generating an RSA key takes a few seconds.
keygen.folderMissing: This folder does not exist. Create it, or choose another one.
keygen.folderDenied: Carapace cannot write to this folder. Choose another one.
keygen.fileExists: {file} or {file}.pub already exists in this folder.

import.pathHint: An OpenSSH private key. The file is not copied: it stays where it is and is only registered.
import.passphraseNote: Only needed to remember the passphrase of an encrypted key.

validation.nameMax: Name must be at most {max} characters
validation.nameTaken: A key with this name already exists
validation.fileNameMax: File name must be at most {max} characters
validation.fileNameDot: File name must not start with "."
validation.fileNameChars: File name may only contain letters, digits, ".", "_" and "-"
validation.commentMax: Comment must be at most {max} characters
validation.commentLine: Comment must be a single line
validation.passphraseMax: Passphrase must be at most {max} characters
validation.pathAbsolute: Use an absolute path or one starting with ~/
validation.folderRequired: Choose a folder for the key.
validation.folderAbsolute: Use a full path, or one starting with ~/.
